notes: SYNTHETIC. Every party, agent, contact reference and identifier below is invented. Parties are marked (FICTIONAL), addresses use .example domains and RFC 5737 / RFC 3849 literals, and no real customer, institution or conversation is represented.
headline: Non-compliant: significant exclusions were never explained before the sale.

turns.text: Good afternoon, Southern Cross Mutual (FICTIONAL) here. Just so you know, we collect your personal information to give you a quote.
Let me explain what this policy covers: the building, the contents and temporary accommodation.
We lost the house in the bushfire last summer, so I want to be sure this time.
Understood. There is a cooling off period of fourteen days if you change your mind.
Are you happy to proceed with the policy?
Thank you. If you are unhappy you can complain to us through our internal dispute resolution process.
